items.question: Which deities are enumerated among the Rudras here?
items.inference: The verse names Ajaikapād, Ahirbudhnya, Pūṣan, and others among the Rudras.
uncertainties: The exact full list beyond 'and so forth' is not given in this verse.
items.plain_english: Ajaikapād, Ahirbudhnya, Pūṣan, and so forth are proclaimed.
